description: AVEVA PI System is an operational data management platform, often called a data historian, that collects, cleans, stores, enriches and visualises real-time and historical time-series data from industrial operations. Its portfolio includes PI Server for storage and analytics, Edge Data Store for remote assets, PI Vision for dashboards, PI DataLink for Excel and a family of interfaces, connectors and adapters, plus developer APIs. It is produced by AVEVA, which reports use by all top 25 pharmaceutical companies, over 1,000 utilities, most oil and gas production and 9 of the top 10 mining companies. Coverage is global; deployments are hybrid across edge, on-premises and cloud components. Licensing is subscription-based and commercial, so cost is paid and no free tier is stated. Caveats: data stay inside each operator's installation, so the platform is a tool for owners, not a public data source, and vendor claims on adoption come from the product page. For simulation it is the usual data backbone of industrial digital twins, feeding process models, condition monitoring and resilience analyses with sensor histories, and it is related to the OPC UA record in this catalogue, which covers the connectivity standard it supports.
